title: Full-stack MERN developer
description: A 3-year MongoDB/Express/React/Node.js developer evaluated against 8 postings: a strong full-stack match with GraphQL/AWS gaps, a semantic match written entirely in generic stack-agnostic vocabulary, a marginal React Native role, and five cross-family distractors.
rationale: j2 is the semantic-no-keyword-overlap job: it describes exactly the resume's MERN competency ('a single language across client and server', 'schema-flexible document data stores', 'declarative component-based UI frameworks', 'non-blocking server runtimes') while sharing essentially no tokens with the resume's skill names — TF-IDF gets no signal, embeddings should still rank it grade 2. j3 (React Native with native Swift/Kotlin modules) is the marginal case: genuine React/TypeScript overlap, but the core family is native mobile delivery, so grade 1. The five distractors span SRE, machine learning, Salesforce administration, embedded firmware, and marketing to test cross-family separation. Gap target j1 overlaps fully on React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Jest, with GraphQL and AWS as unambiguous required-skill gaps and Next.js/Redis as preferred gaps.

resume.summary: Full-stack developer with 3 years of experience shipping web products on the MERN stack. Comfortable owning a feature from MongoDB schema and Express API through the React UI, with typed code in TypeScript and solid Jest test coverage.

jobs.raw_text:
Full-Stack Engineer — Harborview Software (Remote, US)

Harborview builds shipment-tracking software for freight brokers. We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to own features across our customer portal and API layer.

What you will do:
- Build and evolve REST and GraphQL APIs with Node.js and Express
- Design MongoDB schemas and aggregation pipelines for shipment tracking data
- Develop React/TypeScript views for the customer-facing portal
- Maintain Jest test suites and CI checks across the stack

Requirements: React, TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, AWS. 3+ years building production web applications end to end, plus experience deploying and operating services on AWS. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have: Next.js, Redis, Kubernetes.

Product Engineer, Web Platform — Foldline (Hybrid, Raleigh NC)

Foldline builds scheduling tools for home-service businesses. We are deliberately unopinionated about brand names — we hire for fundamentals and teach the specifics.

You will ship end-to-end product features using a single modern language on both client and server, model product data in a schema-flexible document store, and build interactive views with a declarative, component-based UI framework.

We look for: fluency in one modern language across client and server, experience with document-oriented data stores, comfort with component-based frontend frameworks, and thoughtful HTTP API design. 2+ years building web products end to end. Bonus: event-driven non-blocking server runtimes, containerized deployments.
